Class StructureRegistry

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.structures.StructureRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDebuggable, StructureDeletionManager.IDeletionListener
@Singleton public final class StructureRegistry extends Object implements IDebuggable, StructureDeletionManager.IDeletionListener
Represents a registry of structures.

    • isRegistered

      public boolean isRegistered(Structure structure)
      Checks if the exact instance of the provided Structure has been registered. (i.e. it uses '==' to check if the cached entry is the same).
      Parameters:
      structure - The structure.
      Returns:
      True if an entry exists for the exact instance of the provided Structure.

    • putIfAbsent

      public Optional<Structure> putIfAbsent(Structure structure)
      Puts a new Structure in the cache if it does not exist yet.
      Parameters:
      structure - The structure to put in the cache.
      Returns:
      An empty Optional if the structure was successfully put in the cache. If a mapping already existed, the old structure will be returned instead.
